name: Idolatry
overview: Scripture reveals the seriousness of idolatry as seen when God commands Jacob to remove all strange gods from his household and make an altar to the true God at Bethel, emphasizing exclusive worship (Genesis 35:1-4). God's judgment against the gods of Egypt further underscores His sovereignty and intolerance of idolatry (Exodus 12:12). The call to worship God alone is foundational, as introduced in the giving of God's commandments (Exodus 20:1), highlighting the necessity of rejecting all forms of idolatrous practices.
